blocks.text: A competing line around Kahan Singh and the Bandai faction develops arrangements with the Turks, including payments, escorts, and identifying forms such as distinctive blue dress.
At the same time messages go out so that pilgrimage and congregation at Amritsar can continue under a controlled political arrangement.
The blue dress marks outward divergence as the split deepens between Khalsa and Bandai practice.
